# Fonts

`DejaVuSans.ttf` is the DejaVu Sans font (https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/), used by
`Reports::ExportReportService` to render UTF-8 text (e.g. Polish characters) in PDF
exports, because Prawn's built-in fonts only support Windows-1252.

DejaVu fonts are derived from Bitstream Vera and are distributed under a free licence
that permits redistribution and embedding (see https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/License.html).
